controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-13T10:10:06.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-13T11:10:06.000Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
        AND (message LIKE "*pty*" OR message LIKE "*PTY*" OR message LIKE "*tty*")
| KEEP @timestamp, message, host.name
| SORT @timestamp ASC
